narrative: Today's technology briefing highlights significant developments in AI and cybersecurity, alongside updates in consumer tech and space exploration. Key themes include the expanding role of AI assistants, major data breaches, and advancements in foundational technology.

highlights.title: NYC Health and Hospitals says hackers stole medical data and fingerprints during breach affecting at least 1.8 million people
highlights.whyItMatters: The New York public healthcare system said hackers stole personal and medical data, and scans of biometrics — including fingerprints — in one of the largest recorded breaches of 2026.

highlights.title: Inside Anduril and Meta’s quest to make smart glasses for warfare
highlights.whyItMatters: The defense-tech company Anduril has shared new details about the augmented-reality headset for the military it’s prototyping with Meta, including a vision for ordering drone strikes via eye-tracking and voice commands.
